statement: At ledger/theorems.jsonl#sha256:ce42d205e761, 30 rows carry conclusion_type=theorem with no artifact_refs (A0 HF-01 fires). A deterministic class-bound proposal resolves all 30 rows to 148 refs whose paths, sha256 and line locators verify on disk; 0 source_ids are unresolved, 0 class_ids fall outside the frozen four, and the canonical ledger is byte-unchanged. The proposal adds locator/provenance pins only and does not upgrade any verification_status.
assumptions: inputs pinned at ledger/theorems.jsonl ce42d205, ledger/citation_audit.csv 315c1914, artifacts/literature/registry.jsonl ea02d194
citation_audit.csv citation_ids are unique, so line locators are stable
A0 HF-01 is a mechanical detector of theorem-marker-without-resolvable-ref, not a support metric
no network access was used; only local files were read
falsifier: any theorem row left without artifact_refs after applying the patch -> HF-01 stands
any cited locator that does not resolve at the pinned sha256 -> proposal fails
any proposed class binding outside the frozen four -> HF-02 fires
a row_content_sha256 that does not recompute from the canonical row -> proposal fails
a non-deterministic rebuild (two runs differ) -> proposal fails
